title: People Whose List Of Favorite Companies Is Not A Subset Of Another List
description: Find indices of companies lists that are not a subset of any other list.
pseudocode:
1. Sort lists by size descending
2. For each list, check if it is a subset of any already accepted list
3. If not, add to result set
4. Return sorted result indices

steps.note: Sort lists by length descending: [A, B, C], [A, B], [C]
Check first list [A, B, C]. It is not a subset of any, keep it.
Check second list [A, B]. It is a subset of [A, B, C]. Skip it.
Check third list [C]. It is a subset of [A, B, C]. Skip it.
